areas_source_key_length.name: areas_source_key_length
areas_source_key_length.value: "restro"."areas"."source_key" is null or length("restro"."areas"."source_key") between 1 and 128

assets_stored_is_complete.name: assets_stored_is_complete
assets_stored_is_complete.value: "restro"."assets"."status" <> 'stored' or ("restro"."assets"."checksum" is not null and "restro"."assets"."storage_key" is not null and "restro"."assets"."content_type" is not null)

events_style_scope.name: events_style_scope
events_style_scope.value: "restro"."events"."op" not in ('setStyle', 'setStyleStatus') or ("restro"."events"."scope" = 'master' and "restro"."events"."field_key" in ('style', 'style_status') and "restro"."events"."layer" = 'manual')

events_is_a_change.name: events_is_a_change
events_is_a_change.value: "restro"."events"."old_value" is not null or "restro"."events"."new_value" is not null

field_values_till_provenance.name: field_values_till_provenance
field_values_till_provenance.value: "restro"."field_values"."layer" <> 'till' or ("restro"."field_values"."source_record_id" is not null and "restro"."field_values"."mapping_version" is not null)

locks_holder_deadline.name: locks_holder_deadline
locks_holder_deadline.value: "restro"."locks"."holder" is null or ("restro"."locks"."deadline" is not null) = ("restro"."locks"."scope" <> 'payment_table')

log_entries_ids.name: log_entries_ids
log_entries_ids.value: ("restro"."log_entries"."sent_order_id" is null or "restro"."log_entries"."sent_order_id" ~ '^so_[0-9A-Za-z]+$') and ("restro"."log_entries"."payment_id" is null or "restro"."log_entries"."payment_id" ~ '^py_[0-9A-Za-z]+$') and ("restro"."log_entries"."table_id" is null or "restro"."log_entries"."table_id" ~ '^tb_[0-9A-Za-z]+$') and ("restro"."log_entries"."sitting_id" is null or "restro"."log_entries"."sitting_id" ~ '^st_[0-9A-Za-z]+$')

menus_name_length.name: menus_name_length
menus_name_length.value: "restro"."menus"."name" is null or (char_length("restro"."menus"."name") between 1 and 120 and "restro"."menus"."name" = btrim("restro"."menus"."name"))

pauses_target_matches_scope.name: pauses_target_matches_scope
pauses_target_matches_scope.value: ("restro"."pauses"."scope" = 'connection' and "restro"."pauses"."target_id" ~ '^in_[0-9A-Za-z]+$') or ("restro"."pauses"."scope" = 'venue' and "restro"."pauses"."target_id" ~ '^vn_[0-9A-Za-z]+$') or ("restro"."pauses"."scope" = 'bar' and "restro"."pauses"."target_id" ~ '^br_[0-9A-Za-z]+$') or ("restro"."pauses"."scope" = 'table' and "restro"."pauses"."target_id" ~ '^tb_[0-9A-Za-z]+$')

payment_accounts_connected_has_account.name: payment_accounts_connected_has_account
payment_accounts_connected_has_account.value: "restro"."payment_accounts"."state" not in ('connected', 'lost_access') or "restro"."payment_accounts"."account_ref" is not null

payment_lines_closed.name: payment_lines_closed
payment_lines_closed.value: ("restro"."payment_lines"."closed_minor" is null) = ("restro"."payment_lines"."closed_quantity" is null) and ("restro"."payment_lines"."closed_quantity" is null or "restro"."payment_lines"."closed_quantity" > 0)

payment_refunds_storno.name: payment_refunds_storno
payment_refunds_storno.value: ("restro"."payment_refunds"."storno_at" is null) = ("restro"."payment_refunds"."storno_by" is null) and ("restro"."payment_refunds"."storno_by" is null or "restro"."payment_refunds"."storno_by" ~ '^(system|guest|(user|staff|integration|operator):[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127})$')

payment_steps_lines.name: payment_steps_lines
payment_steps_lines.value:
"restro"."payment_steps"."lines" is null or ("restro"."payment_steps"."step" = 'undoIsolate' and "restro"."payment_steps"."outcome" = 'attempting'
        and case when jsonb_typeof("restro"."payment_steps"."lines") = 'array'
          then jsonb_array_length("restro"."payment_steps"."lines") between 1 and 500
            and not jsonb_path_exists("restro"."payment_steps"."lines", '$[*] ? (@.type() != "object" || !exists(@.pos) || !exists(@.quantity) || !exists(@.amountMinor) || @.pos.type() != "string" || !(@.pos like_regex "^.{1,200}$") || @.quantity.type() != "string" || !(@.quantity like_regex "^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,14})([.][0-9]{1,6})?$") || @.amountMinor.type() != "number" || @.amountMinor.floor() != @.amountMinor)')
          else false end)

payments_receipt_open_idx.name: payments_receipt_open_idx
payments_receipt_open_idx.where: "restro"."payments"."receipt_to_bring_at" is not null and "restro"."payments"."receipt_brought_at" is null

payments_captured_minor.name: payments_captured_minor
payments_captured_minor.value: "restro"."payments"."captured_minor" is null or ("restro"."payments"."amount_minor" is not null and "restro"."payments"."captured_minor" between 0 and "restro"."payments"."amount_minor")

payments_dispute_times.name: payments_dispute_times
payments_dispute_times.value: ("restro"."payments"."dispute_closed_at" is null or "restro"."payments"."dispute_opened_at" is not null) and ("restro"."payments"."dispute_due_at" is null or "restro"."payments"."dispute_opened_at" is not null)

payments_fiscal_numbers.name: payments_fiscal_numbers
payments_fiscal_numbers.value: ("restro"."payments"."receipt_number" is null or char_length("restro"."payments"."receipt_number") between 1 and 64) and ("restro"."payments"."fiscal_memory_number" is null or char_length("restro"."payments"."fiscal_memory_number") between 1 and 64)

payments_evidence.name: payments_evidence
payments_evidence.value: ("restro"."payments"."three_ds_result" is null or "restro"."payments"."three_ds_result" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$') and ("restro"."payments"."authorisation_code" is null or char_length("restro"."payments"."authorisation_code") between 1 and 64)

payments_receipt_brought.name: payments_receipt_brought
payments_receipt_brought.value: ("restro"."payments"."receipt_brought_at" is null) = ("restro"."payments"."receipt_brought_by" is null) and ("restro"."payments"."receipt_brought_at" is null or "restro"."payments"."receipt_to_bring_at" is not null) and ("restro"."payments"."receipt_brought_by" is null or "restro"."payments"."receipt_brought_by" ~ '^(system|guest|(user|staff|integration|operator):[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127})$') and ("restro"."payments"."receipt_to_bring_at" is null or "restro"."payments"."state" = 'captured')

payments_receipt_email.name: payments_receipt_email
payments_receipt_email.value: "restro"."payments"."receipt_email" is null or (char_length("restro"."payments"."receipt_email") between 3 and 254 and "restro"."payments"."state" in ('requested', 'priced', 'awaiting_guest', 'held', 'queued', 'isolated', 'entered', 'checked'))

snapshots_held_reason.name: snapshots_held_reason
snapshots_held_reason.value: ("restro"."snapshots"."held_reason" is null or ("restro"."snapshots"."reason" = 'auto_sync' and jsonb_typeof("restro"."snapshots"."held_reason") = 'object')) and ("restro"."snapshots"."status" = 'published' or "restro"."snapshots"."held_reason" is not null)

snapshots_decision_note.name: snapshots_decision_note
snapshots_decision_note.value: "restro"."snapshots"."decision_note" is null or ("restro"."snapshots"."decided_by" is not null and "restro"."snapshots"."decision_note" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$')

staff_members_pin_pair.name: staff_members_pin_pair
staff_members_pin_pair.value: ("restro"."staff_members"."pin_hmac" is null) = ("restro"."staff_members"."pin_sealed" is null) and ("restro"."staff_members"."pin_hmac" is null) = ("restro"."staff_members"."pin_set_at" is null)

tables_name_length.name: tables_name_length
tables_name_length.value: "restro"."tables"."name" is null or (char_length("restro"."tables"."name") between 1 and 40 and "restro"."tables"."name" = btrim("restro"."tables"."name"))

tables_number_length.name: tables_number_length
tables_number_length.value: "restro"."tables"."number" is null or (char_length("restro"."tables"."number") between 1 and 40 and "restro"."tables"."number" = btrim("restro"."tables"."number"))

tables_has_label.name: tables_has_label
tables_has_label.value: "restro"."tables"."name" is not null or "restro"."tables"."number" is not null

tables_qr_code_complete.name: tables_qr_code_complete
tables_qr_code_complete.value: ("restro"."tables"."qr_code_hash" is null) = ("restro"."tables"."qr_token" is null and "restro"."tables"."qr_code_sealed" is null)
